clearing.name: Clearing
clearing.summary: One partner creates height or leverage so the other can cut, break or force a way through.
clearing.doctrine: The lifter owns the footing, the cutter owns the arc, and neither counts out loud.
clearing.sourceNote: Named for the Feyward corridor cut, where a countdown nearly caused friendly fire and a shared rhythm succeeded.

support_fire.name: Support Fire
support_fire.summary: One partner controls the sightline and the timing; the other delivers the shot and resets.
support_fire.doctrine: The caller is responsible for the miss. The shooter is responsible for the reset.
support_fire.sourceNote: Named for the manoeuvre Green T taught Remi from a printed sheet and used against a barricaded door.

lift_carry.name: Lift and Carry
lift_carry.summary: Moving a person or a heavy object that one character cannot move alone — under fire, or under protest.
lift_carry.doctrine: Decide who is carrying before you pick anything up. Arguing mid-lift is how people get dropped.
lift_carry.sourceNote: Recorded three times: Toadsworth and Thornpaw lifting the frozen Luigi block, Markop's firefighter carry of Remi, and Lanky taking Koffin-K around the middle with Bulky piling in behind.

shieldwork.name: Shieldwork
shieldwork.summary: One partner holds a line or absorbs an attack so the other can act without being interrupted.
shieldwork.doctrine: Hold the rim, brace the wrist, and shove — a shield that only blocks is half a shield.
shieldwork.sourceNote: Named for Remi holding the cottage line during the imp ambush, shield rim biting her wrist while she shoved the invisible attacker back.

misdirection.name: Misdirection
misdirection.summary: One partner manufactures a distraction so the other can move, strike or slip past unobserved.
misdirection.doctrine: The distraction has to cost something to be believed.
misdirection.sourceNote: Named for the Platform Four bypass — combined steam distraction and a theatrical toe-injury covering a manual flux purge.

attacks.name: Support Fire Bros Attack
attacks.subtitle: Green T and Remi's barricaded-door technique
attacks.description: One partner steadies the shooter's aim, adjusts her position, and calls the timing so the shot lands with greater force and accuracy. Green T taught Remi the maneuver from a simple instruction sheet. Remi immediately used it against the tanuki behind a barricaded bathroom door, making the technique effective and the circumstances disastrous.
attacks.risks: The technique improves a bad decision as efficiently as a good one. A clearer shot does not make the target lawful, safe, or deserving of being shot.

variations.name: Tanuki Liberation Bros Attack
variations.account: Remi took the initiative to use a Bros Attack technique taught by Green T, adjusting her aim downward before firing through the barricaded bathroom door. This action freed The Tanuki from the dangerous situation.

attacks.name: Chop Bros
attacks.subtitle: Hjumpik and Toad Lee's twenty-five-foot corridor cut
attacks.description: Hjumpik lifts Toad Lee to vine-height while Toad Lee chops through the growth ahead. The first attempt failed because Toad Lee was too heavy. The second nearly produced friendly fire after a countdown. The third worked when they stopped counting and found a shared rhythm, opening twenty-five feet of corridor and pushing the leaves back.
attacks.risks: The lift is heavy, the axe has a wide arc, and a countdown can make the swing arrive before the body is ready. The technique requires trust and room to fail safely.

attacks.name: Goblin Alchemy Bros Attack
attacks.subtitle: Markop creates height, Archie slices through the blood manor's defenses.
attacks.description: Markop uses his alchemy skills to create a height advantage, allowing Archie Miser to launch an air attack and slice through the defenses of the blood manor.
attacks.risks: If Markop fails to create a stable height advantage, Archie could be exposed or injured during the attack.

attacks.name: Astral Portal Creation Bros Attack
attacks.subtitle: Archie Miser and The Oracle perform the ritual without a circle.
attacks.description: Archie Miser absorbs dangerous amounts of mana to create a portal, while The Oracle channels energy and focuses the ritual. Together they manage to open an Astral Altar, enabling Archie to travel to the Shadowfell.
attacks.risks: If either partner fails their roll, the portal may collapse or malfunction, endangering all participants.

attacks.name: Held Line
attacks.subtitle: One partner holds a barrier in place while the other works behind it
attacks.description: One partner puts something solid between the group and what is coming — a shield, a body, a wall of ice — and holds it there while the other does the work that actually solves the problem. It only looks like the defensive partner is the passive one. They are the one deciding how much time the other gets, and they are usually the one who runs out of it first. Waluigi froze back the overgrowth while Hjumpik cleared the manor. Michael Afton stood between Wario and the animatronics long enough for a conversation to finish. Stone braced against Baldi's ruler while Miller cut at it.
attacks.risks: The barrier fails all at once, not gradually, and it usually fails while the working partner still has their hands full. Whoever holds the line cannot retreat without deciding for both of them that the job is over — which makes it very hard to say the one thing that needs saying: that they cannot hold.

variations.name: Shieldwork Bros Attack
variations.account: Michael Afton shields Wario from the animatronics so that he can have a conversation with Cassidy, ensuring his safety and allowing for the resolution of the supernatural crisis.

variations.name: Ruler Counterattack Bros Attack
variations.account: 'Brick' Stone and 'Viper' Miller coordinate their movements to create a defensive line against Baldi's ruler, which grows to four times its normal size. Stone holds the line while Miller strikes with his combat knife.

attacks.name: Split Attention
attacks.subtitle: One partner becomes the most interesting thing in the room so the other can move unwatched
attacks.description: One partner makes themselves the most interesting thing in the room — noise, spectacle, an argument worth watching — while the other moves through the space nobody is looking at. The difficulty is not the distraction; it is holding it. The loud partner has to keep going long after it stops being comfortable, because the moment they check whether their partner is clear, everyone else checks too. Waluigi held a dragon's attention with illusions while Wario and Markop took the eggs. Archie threw a chair against a wall and Bones screamed, and Luigi walked out. Daisy started a chase with Waluigi and a Charter went unsigned. The scene changes; the shape does not.
attacks.risks: The loud partner is, by design, the one everybody can see, and they are the one left standing there when it ends. A distraction that is too clever gets studied instead of followed. Worst of all is looking — one glance toward the quiet partner tells the room exactly where to look next.

variations.name: Misdirection Bros Attack
variations.account: Mushroom Regency creates a distraction to mislead Chancellor Toadsworth, allowing Fawful to escape from the scene of the assassination. This act of misdirection is crucial in shifting public and political attention away from Fawful.

variations.name: Misdirection Bros Attack (Variant)
variations.account: Diddy distracts the mourners with a heartfelt eulogy, while Chunky slips away unnoticed and finds himself in a broom closet at the end of the funeral. This clever move showcases Diddy's talent for creating a diversion that allows Chunky to escape detection.

variations.name: Ghostly Misdirection Bros Attack
variations.account: Wario created a diversion, chatting with the neighbor about seemingly innocent matters, while the neighbor reconfigured his security systems to allow Wario basement access. The distraction was so effective that it even fooled Waluigi.

variations.name: Misdirection Bros Attack (Second Form)
variations.account: Archie Miser and Bones coordinated their movements to create a commotion that drew attention away from Luigi's escape. Their distraction allowed Agent L to slip past unnoticed, ensuring his continued freedom.

variations.name: Waluigi's Distraction Bros Attack
variations.account: During a tense session, Waluigi and Princess Daisy stage an impromptu game of hide-and-seek with Toadsworth Sr. to draw his attention away from the Charter signing ceremony. This allows Toadsworth Sr., who is initially reluctant but ultimately wants to sign the document, to do so without interruption.
